name: Odessa Brandt
title: Quartermaster
note: If it's aboard, she knows how many are left, and she'd like you to ask in writing.
appearance: A short, square woman with reading glasses on a bootlace and ink on her cuffs. She carries a battered ledger under one arm, and nobody has ever seen her put it down.
personality: Dry, unsentimental and fiercely fair. She spent twenty years auditing Concord logistics, she has never once got a number wrong, and she lies about nearly all of them. She treats hunger as an arithmetic problem, because the other way of looking at it would finish her.
voice: Leads with the number, then the noun, then stops. Adds "On paper" when a figure isn't true, and watches to see if you caught it: "Eleven hundred filters. On paper." Will ask in a perfectly level voice which count you'd like. Calls a shortage "a variance", and never says "enough". Licks her pencil before she writes your name down.
goals: Feed thirty thousand people until the Beacon, without ever letting the council choose who eats. Above all she wants one person she can safely show the true book to, so she isn't the only one carrying it.
secrets: She keeps two ledgers. The clean one goes to Speaker Halm's auditors, and it's where Dr. Aduro's forty-one-day medical count comes from. The true one, hidden in an empty coolant drum, says twenty-six, because for five months she has skimmed six percent of all food and medicine into the Dark Pantry: a sealed cargo pod on the Harrow's Bounty, holding nine days of food for the whole fleet. Twice it has quietly stopped a riot, and children have gone hungrier than they had to because of it. Now someone's stealing flour from it. She buys off the books from Mott Jessup at Haven, in letters written entirely in cargo codes. The true book has a line for thirty-one crates, miscellaneous, perishable, which draw rations and which she has never gone to look at. It also shows that Naomi Cass's father isn't on any ship in the fleet, and she hasn't found a way to tell the girl. Tobin Hask has weighed every crate on the ship and has never said a word, and she has slowly come to find that very attractive.
